_comment: All ballistics math runs in METRES and SECONDS. The Roblox layer converts at the engine boundary using studsPerMetre. Nothing here may be duplicated in Luau.
_dragModel: Quadratic drag linearised along the flight path: v(s) = v0 * exp(-k*s). k has units 1/m. 1/k is the distance over which speed falls by 1/e.

simulation._maxStepsPerFrame: How many fixed steps one Heartbeat may run. The catch-up loop was unbounded: a one-second stall -- an asset load, a Studio breakpoint, a hitching client on a weak machine -- asked for sixty steps of twelve bots and every projectile inside a single frame, which takes longer than a frame, which makes the next dt larger. That is the spiral, and it turns one hitch into a freeze. Five steps is 83 ms of simulated time per frame: enough to absorb ordinary jitter, bounded enough that a stall costs simulated time instead of the server. Time past the cap is DROPPED rather than carried, because carrying it is the spiral written a different way.

_designTargets.note: These are the two numbers the whole skill curve rests on. Ballistics specs assert against them, and tools/tune-report regenerates them.
